summary: Namaskar propajee ap je kompetent par is tutorial mein aapka swagat hai. Is tutorial mein hum neem neem se learnenge periodic table trans aur abikriya banana. Apko jekampanet kompilator structure aditor ke saath parichit hona chahhiye. Je kompanet window khulne ke liye, desktop pe dosya desktop par terminal open karo - cd space desktop enter, aur je kompanet space java enter karo. Ab periodic table trans ke saath shukarathe hain. Toolbar ke niche few important elements dekhate hain. Toolbar par dhaane tarav double click karke ek window open hoga. Yeh sapt chujj ke ek element window dekhne mein madad karta hain. Element ka vikaran dekhne ke liye, window close karo, element symbol vaya box par click karo, panel par click karo, element text box open hoga. Element ka symbol type karo, yeh panel par display hoga. Ab jeon pluri je ek app open karo, functions menu par jaaye, pratreshis par click karo, pratreshis window open hoga.
